What the ligand engages: a cavity in one chain, which the ligand stabilises; the region folds around it
Representative evidence: MDM2 lid / AM-7209: defined hydrophobic contact set, mutatable to loss of binding, resolved structure, local helicity gain on binding[52]; TREX1 α7–α8 loop / PV6R derivatives: X-ray structures of the complexes, with an ordered state that is inhibitor-dependent[42]
Can a single-chain ensemble represent it: Yes, with a caveat — a ligand-specific induced conformation is not an apo-ensemble property (§4)

What the ligand engages: an interface between chains in a transient oligomer, whose population the ligand shifts
Representative evidence: p27Kip1: sedimentation-velocity AUC shows SJ755 drives 52% of chains into a compact dimer and SJ757 drives 90% into soluble oligomers of three to ten chains, with the authors' model being multivalent compounds cross-linking aromatic clusters in different molecules[13]; AR Tau-5 intermolecular PREs and intermolecular aromatic NOEs, with simulated dimerisation Kd falling 1.8 → 0.30 mM across the ligand series[15,16]
Can a single-chain ensemble represent it: No — the binding-competent species is multimeric

What the ligand engages: no cavity; the ligand changes the ensemble's breadth or shape
Representative evidence: α-synuclein entropic expansion[11,17]; Aβ42 non-specific binding with a low-population transient β-sheet[24,25]
Can a single-chain ensemble represent it: No — the observable is a distribution property, not a site

Class: Covalent capture (added after a systematic search; see below)
What the ligand engages: an accessible reactive residue in a permissive local sequence context, engaged irreversibly, with the consequence being destabilisation rather than occupancy
Representative evidence: MYC: a sulfinyl aziridine whose adduct maps to C203 on purified protein, requires D205 for activity in cells, and lowers the MYC melting temperature by 6.4 °C rather than raising it[34]
Can a single-chain ensemble represent it: Partly — a single-chain ensemble can report side-chain solvent accessibility and local sequence context, which are the relevant quantities, but PWTP measures neither
